tools.name: weather_now
tools.description: Current weather at a place: temperature (°C), humidity (%), pressure (hPa) and wind (m/s) from the nearest live Open-Meteo relay within 75 km, with a signed receipt. Send latitude and longitude, or a city.

tools.name: air_quality_now
tools.description: Current air quality at a place: PM2.5 and PM10 (µg/m³), US and European AQI, from Copernicus CAMS via Open-Meteo, with a signed receipt. Send latitude and longitude, or a city.

tools.name: nearby_sensors
tools.description: The nearest live public sensors to a point, one per layer asked for (weather, air, radiation, quake …), each with its reading, distance and source, and a signed receipt.
